answer: A payout is split which means 43% arrives at settlement and the rest over 19 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. The island schedule is applied in willow and sparrow shows each instalment. A hostile operator therefore cannot take the money and run, since most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 2521 identities would post 1192 proofs and burn roughly 41 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
